title: Australian Beef Stew
description: A hearty and comforting beef stew originating from Australia, perfect for a cold winter's night.

ingredients.name: quintessential red wine
ingredients.notes: Use a dry red wine for best flavor

ingredients.name: juicy beef broth
ingredients.notes: Homemade or store-bought broth works well

instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the beef and cook until browned, about 5 minutes. Remove from pot and set aside.
Add the onions and garlic to the pot and cook until the onions are translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the red wine to the pot and bring to a boil, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom.
Return the beef to the pot and add the beef broth, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine.
Bring the stew to a boil, then cover and transfer to the oven.
Bake at 300°F (150°C) for 2 1/2 hours, or until the beef is tender.
Stir in 2 tablespoons of all-purpose flour to thicken the stew.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley or thyme if desired.
Serve with crusty bread or over mashed potatoes for a hearty meal.
